name: Grunge Era Rock
description: The guitar-driven alternative and hard-rock lane of 1991–1998: Seattle grunge at the center, with compatible post-grunge and alternative radio around it.

notes: This is intentionally broader than pure grunge, but it is not a general 1990s pop or nu-metal station.
The core is Seattle grunge and its closest contemporaries; approved artists represent compatible alternative-rock expansion.
Material after 1998 belongs in a later format unless explicitly reviewed.

sourceBasis.finding: Documents Seattle alternative-radio programming from the period; the station launched in 1991 as the Seattle grunge scene became national.

sourceBasis.source: RockLists — Alternative & Modern Rock Radio Countdowns
sourceBasis.finding: Provides cross-market alternative-radio evidence spanning grunge, post-punk, indie, and modern rock rather than relying on one city or one retrospective playlist.
Provides a historical account of the modern-rock format's transition through 1991 and the subsequent dominance of grunge-derived rock radio.
Used as a contemporary format cross-check for a 1990s rock/grunge programming lane.

excludedArtists.reason: Primarily later than this station's period.
Nu metal; outside the era and format.
Nu metal; outside this station's intended lane.

maintenanceNotes: Keep this mix distinct from a future '90s Alternative' mix by maintaining the guitar-driven, grunge-centered rule.
The user’s ratings and Favorites should decide emphasis among eligible tracks; they should not make an ineligible later/nu-metal track eligible.
Use excludedTracks for particular songs that are too pop, too electronic, or otherwise wrong for the station despite an approved artist.
